question: Karachi session of Indian National Congress was held in 1931. It was presided over by:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sardar Patel**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Karachi session of Indian National Congress** 

 
 
• **Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel** presided over the Karachi Congress Session, which took place from March **26 to 31, 1931**. 
 
• The fundamental rights resolution and economic program were written by **Pandit Jawahar Lal Nehru**.
 
• At a particularly special meeting of the **Indian National Congress, Mahatma Gandhi was chosen to represent the organisation** at the Second Round Table Conference, which would take place in London.
 
• The** Gandhi-Irwin Pact**, sometimes known as the Delhi Pact, was also discussed during the meeting.
 
• **Bhagat Singh, Rajguru, and Sukhdev** were hanged six days before this meeting.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel 

 
 
• From 1**947 to 1950, Sardar, also known as Vallabhbhai Jhaverbhai Patel**, was India's first Deputy Prime Minister and Home Minister.
 
• He was also a prominent **political figure, lawyer, and politician**.
 
• He is referred to as** India's Iron Man**.
 
• The title **"Sardar"** was given to Vallabhbhai Patel by the **women of Bardoli**, with **Gandhi playing a role in propagating it.**
 
• Because of his significant contribution to India's unification, he is often referred to as the **Bismark of India**. 
 
• At a **cost of USD 420 million, the Indian government built the Statue of Unity, the tallest statue in the world**, which was dedicated to him on **October 31, 2018**. Its height is roughly **182 meters (597 feet)**.
